reviewer: Implementation agent self-review; not independent review
scope: Colour, typography, reduced workspace clutter and contextual help

behaviour.layout: Removed the visible introductory heading and empty properties panel. Properties appear only for a selected object. Their desktop overlay does not resize the drawing during a drag.
behaviour.context: Help contains the diagram guide, modelling assumptions and course conventions. Session contains connection settings and learning-record information. Snapping and numerical diagnostics expand on request.
behaviour.retained: Global and selected-member axes, stability and static determinacy remain visible. Sign details, reactions, worked solutions and proof downloads remain accessible. Moment-side controls are shown only for the bending-moment layer.
behaviour.drawing: The shorter SVG viewBox shares its centre with pointer mapping and reserves margins for forces and supports. Right-end vertical-reaction labels move inward; vector origins and directions are unchanged.
behaviour.fonts: Three Source Sans 3 weights and their OFL licence are served locally. Interface results use tabular numerals. KaTeX mathematical fonts are preserved. Removed the Google Fonts request.
behaviour.mathematics: No solver, symbolic derivation, proof source or numerical rounding rule changed. Local Lean execution was not enabled.

readability: Presentation rules are organised by navigation, tools, diagram, results, worked solutions, help and responsive behaviour. Existing element IDs and handlers are preserved; new handlers have one purpose each.

validation.automated: Type check and 35 existing Node tests passed. All 987 published equations, including 960 symbolic forms, rendered successfully with matching certificate hashes.
validation.desktop: Reviewed the drawing, properties, help, worked equations, focus and Escape restoration. Dragging the 20 kN force from x=4 m to the snapped x=5 m gave t=0.625 and V=7.5 kN, M=30 kN m at the x=4 m cut. Portal-frame annotations fitted inside the canvas.
validation.phone: Reviewed the 390 x 844 layout and equation rendering. Reaction labels fit inside the drawing. Fixed an inherited selector that hid the static-determinacy text. No horizontal page overflow was observed.
validation.practice: Results and support reactions remain hidden and the worked solution remains collapsed until reveal.
validation.privacy: Interactive checks used synthetic examples on a separate preview origin; student records and the user's stored model were not changed.
